headline: COP31 Negotiations Stall Over Fossil Fuel Phaseout and Financial Commitments
summary: UN climate negotiations in Turkey reached a standstill as negotiators deliberated a showdown with Saudi Arabia over fossil fuel transition wording, with European delegations warning of leaving without a deal.
why: COP summits negotiate global decarbonisation commitments, shaping long-term policy for energy producers and transition finance flows.

impacts.name: Global Oil & Gas
impacts.why: Stalled phaseout language highlights resistance from oil-producing nations to mandatory fossil fuel reductions.
